module.title: Days 1–10 | Foundation Module
module.description: First ten complete lessons; prepared for admin review before production publishing.

lessons.title: Orientation & exam map
lessons.objective: Understand the exam purpose, sections, question styles and a practical preparation workflow.
lessons.core_teaching_content: This lesson introduces orientation & exam map for Banking – IBPS. Start with a tutor-led explanation of the exam relevance, then model two representative examples. Learners should identify the rule or method, solve guided questions, and explain why each answer is correct. Emphasise accuracy before speed and maintain an error log for questions answered incorrectly or by guessing.
examples: Example A: Tutor demonstrates one Banking – IBPS style question and verbalises the reasoning.
Example B: Learner solves a similar question independently and compares the method with the model.
Transfer example: Change one condition and ask the learner to explain whether the same method still works.
lessons.practical_activity: Timed 8-question practice: 4 guided, 3 independent and 1 challenge question.
lessons.guided_practice: Tutor solves the first two questions with the learner, prompting the learner to state the rule before calculating or selecting an answer.
lessons.independent_practice: Complete the remaining questions without notes; mark each answer as Sure / Unsure / Guess.
questions: What is the main idea behind orientation & exam map?
Which step is easiest to get wrong, and how will you check it?
Solve one new question and explain your reasoning in complete sentences.
What mistake did you make or nearly make today?
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: 8-question checkpoint; target 75% accuracy, with every wrong answer corrected in the error log.
lessons.student_task: Create a one-page revision note containing the key rule/method, two worked examples and three self-test questions.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Model thinking rather than only answers; ask learners to justify choices; record recurring misconceptions and adjust the next practice set.
lessons.reflection_completion: Write: Today I understood ____. I need more practice on ____. My next improvement step is ____.
